text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the 
shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go!
I've prepped the best sparring 
partner for ya! Once you're done 
practicing, simmer it or grill it, it's 
all good!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, mister! You've been a 
huge help.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Indeed, a partner with plenty of 
backbone—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! Wait, ah! No, no, that's not 
what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
By sparring partner, I meant "horse 
mackerel"!
I'm currently practicing how to 
fillet fish.
choice_data_list: Ah, I see. So that's it...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Today's mackerel seems exceptionally 
delicious! Trainer, you should have some 
too if you'd like.
choice_data_list: Oh, I see. So that's how it is...

text_block_list.text:
A few days later. When I stopped by the 
library to return a book...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Books on anatomy... anatomy...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, found it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought,
it varies completely by 
species. Looks like I'll need to adapt my 
filleting technique each time.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
I also need to be particular 
about my knives. A standard deba, an 
aideba, and an ajikiri knife too—

Several days after that. When I went out 
to buy fish for dinner—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome! We've got great squid in 
today~!
choice_data_list: Wait, what are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm helping out at the shop! Since I 
officially apprenticed myself to the 
mister here.

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
You bet! She told me she wanted to learn 
how to clean all kinds of fish!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right now I'm practicing preparing pike 
conger, but bone-cutting is quite 
tricky...
choice_data_list: (H-How far does she plan on taking...
(H-How far does she plan on master...

text_block_list.text:
Though taken aback, I bought the 
recommended squid and headed home that 
day. However—
choice_data_list: (H-how far do you intend to master...
(H-how far does she intend to take...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eye, preparing to carve!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you going to carve it,
Eye-san? This 
colossal tuna...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, exactly! —Now then, everyone, behold!
(Slash! Swish! Slice-slice-slice!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A-Astonishment at 50 miles per hour...! 
That super giant tuna turned into fillets 
in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Clean cuts without a single wasted 
motion. Flawless tool selection. 
Eye-senpai, where did you learn such 
technique?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I wanted to be able to fillet like 
you, so I practiced a lot!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
During our mountain retreat training, the 
way you filleted salmon was so 
incredible... Honestly, it made me feel 
frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Since I cook too, I felt like—I couldn't 
afford to lose!
choice_data_list: S-So that was what sparked this!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... that tuna was far too big of a 
long shot.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. But my master is even more amazing, 
you know?
It will still take me quite some 
time to surpass him.
choice_data_list: Wait, you're planning on beating y...
Wait, you're planning to beat your...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I need to polish my skills even more
as 
well. I shouldn't just be satisfied with 
merely 'being able to do it.'
choice_data_list: Wait, you're planning to beat even...
Wait, you're planning on beating y...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
...By the way. What shall we do with all 
the carved tuna? It will spoil if left as 
is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We eat it deliciously, of course! ...A 
"hand-rolled sushi party" or an
"all-sorts 
tuna dish festival," which would you 
prefer?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaai! Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only 
You~! We're having a hand-rolled sushi 
party with everyone right now~♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wow! Bouquet-chan's hand-rolled 
sushi looks just like a real bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquet Doll
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Since we have this opportunity, 
I thought I'd get creative with it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It really is wonderful! I'd love for you 
to teach me how to make it too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
All right! Deliciousness at 100 miles per 
hour! The "Hawaiian Tuna Salad" is 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The "ara-jiru" fish-head soup and 
"simmered tuna eye" are ready as well. 
...Chrono-san, is that a boat platter?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ...Umm, Eye-san filleted it so 
beautifully, so... I-I'm sorry all I did 
was arrange the plate...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Everything looks so delicious!
—Looks like 
next time, I need to study food 
presentation.
